questions.question: Which empire now rose to threaten and conquer Judah?
What did Nebuchadnezzar do to Jerusalem in this chapter?
options: Spared it in exchange for a yearly payment of tribute
Besieged it and carried away King Jehoiachin and many people
Rebuilt its broken walls and restored the temple
Passed it by entirely and marched on toward Egypt
questions.answer: Besieged it and carried away King Jehoiachin and many people
